summary: Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter
description: The bug Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter. How to reproduce - Execute the command: give s jigsaw - Open the jigsaw block (displaying the user interface) - Type in any of the text boxes, characters: or {} (invalid unicode characters blocking the "done" button) - Press the enter key The game crashes Crash report 1.14.3-pre3 : [ crash-2019-06-16_22.54.27-client.txt] Description: keyPressed event handler n: Non [a-z0-9 ._-] character in path of location: minecraft:empty at qt. (SourceFile:38) at qt. (SourceFile:43) at dbo.d(SourceFile:44) at dbo.b(SourceFile:35) at dbo.keyPressed(SourceFile:106) at cvm.a(SourceFile:410) at cvm Lambda 3043 1332786777.run(Unknown Source) at czx.wrapScreenError(SourceFile:441) at cvm.a(SourceFile:408) at cvm Lambda 1477 601932288.invoke(Unknown Source) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFWKeyCallbackI.callback(GLFWKeyCallbackI.java:37) at org.lwjgl.system.JNI.invokeV(Native Method) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.glfwPollEvents(GLFW.java:3101) at cuh.l(SourceFile:425) at cuh.c(SourceFile:283) at cvo.b(SourceFile:1023) at cvo.e(SourceFile:976) at cvo.b(SourceFile:411) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:154)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Execute the command: `/give @s jigsaw`.
4. Place the jigsaw block in your inventory into the world.
5. Right-click the jigsaw block to open its user interface.
6. Type any of the invalid characters `or {}` into one of the text boxes.
7. Press the Enter key on your keyboard.
8. Observe that the game crashes upon pressing Enter.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.14.2, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 3, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 4, 1.14.3
Observed Behavior:
When invalid characters such as "{" or "}" are entered into the text boxes of a jigsaw block's user interface and the enter key is pressed, the game crashes. This issue can be reproduced by executing the command `/give @s jigsaw`, opening the jigsaw block to display its user interface, typing invalid Unicode characters in any of the text fields (which blocks the "done" button), and then pressing the enter key. The crash occurs due to a non-compliant character being present in the path location, specifically at `qt` within `SourceFile:38`. This triggers an error in the keyPressed event handler, leading to a game crash with the specific error message indicating that there is a non `[a-z0-9 ._-]` character in the path of location `minecraft:empty`.

To provide further context for developers, it's important to include relevant files such as screenshots highlighting the discrepancy before and after the crash, a ZIP archive of the game’s debug folder, the latest log file (`latest.log`), and the corresponding crash report from `crash-reports/*.txt`. Additionally, if the bug is world-specific, including the zipped world save folder can be beneficial. These steps ensure that developers have all necessary information to diagnose and address the issue effectively.
Expected Behavior: When invalid characters such as {} are entered into the jigsaw block interface and the enter key is pressed, the game should not crash. Instead, it should display an error message indicating that the input contains invalid characters and prevent any changes from being applied until valid input is provided. The game should remain stable and allow the user to correct their input or cancel the operation without crashing.
